scope: Source-repository maintenance only: whether skillOverrides can hide the Claude adapters' nested rd-* Skills while keeping the account-synced anthropic-skills:rd-* copies. Not a distributed-adapter setting.
evidence_level: Headless runtime observation, one run per variant; Skill tool results and the stream-json init Skill list are recorded directly, later listing presence is model-reported

method.client: claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --model sonnet --permission-mode default --allowedTools Read Skill --no-session-persistence
method.fixture: Fresh temporary git repository outside this repository containing claude/project/.claude/skills/rd-research/SKILL.md and zh-CN/claude/project/.claude/skills/rd-research/SKILL.md copied from base_commit, plus one placeholder note.md beside each adapter; the variant's skillOverrides in the fixture's .claude/settings.json
method.trigger: Reading claude/project/note.md (single-adapter runs) or both note.md files (dual-adapter runs) loads the nested Skills
method.probes: After the reads, the Skill tool was called with each candidate name and the first line of each result was recorded
method.account_state: Nine rd-* Skills synced from the claude.ai account; no personal ~/.claude/skills/rd-* copies; existing user-level settings and context retained
method.record_form: Tool-result first lines and init Skill lists; raw transcripts were not retained

limits: One run per variant; the interactive / menu was not checked.
The skills documentation does not state that a bare skillOverrides key matches a directory-qualified nested Skill; recheck after CLI upgrades.
A bare off key also hides personal or project Skills with the same name.
Only rd-research and rd-review were invoked; the other seven names were checked through the init Skill list only.
The bare-name behavior before any nested load was not probed.
